answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 67228 Country: India Title: If someone is sleeping on Masjid's saf after putting bed-sheet (2 or 3 folds) and the liquid is passed on by the bed-sheet then what to do? Question: If someone is sleeping on Masjid's saf after putting bed-sheet (2 or 3 folds) and the liquid is passed on by the bed-sheet then what to do? Answer ID: 67228 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1198/1250/L=11/1437) In the above mentioned case, he should wash out the impurity which is smeared in the mat or rug etc of the mosque and make it pure. The method of cleaning is that water is poured on it thrice and squeezed thrice. And if it is not possible to squeeze it then each time it should be left out for awhile until the water stops dropping. It shall be equal to squeezing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
